caption: The drawing features three views of a gold-colored pocket watch against a plain, off-white background. At the top left is a front-facing view of the closed pocket watch, which has a circular shape with an ornate frame and a small loop at the top for attaching a chain; the center of the watch's cover is decorated with a detailed engraving of a landscape featuring a house and several trees. To the right of this, there is a side view of the same pocket watch, showing its thickness and outer rim, which also displays engraved decorative lines. Below these two views, there is an illustration of the pocket watch open, with its cover swung to the left; the inside of the cover appears plain, while the inside of the main body displays a faint pencil or graphite portrait of a person on the watch’s inner lid. The drawing is labeled “Westchester County” on the lower left and is signed "Drawn by Wm P. Shearwood" on the lower right. The overall color palette consists mainly of shades of yellow and gold for the watch, with subtle gray and pencil tones for the interior portrait and engraved details.
title: Watch Chain Locket
